crossRefs.note: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.
For Yahweh has comforted Zion. He has comforted all her waste places, and has made her wilderness like Eden, and her…
How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who…
Behold, Yahweh has proclaimed to the end of the earth, “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes!…
Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and…
All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,
The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,
The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.
translations.kjv: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
translations.asv: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced, Because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.
